questions.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
questions.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

questions.q: A factory manager praised a production line after one unusually productive morning. The annual report, however, showed repeated delays and large repair costs. Which advice is best supported?
o: Celebrate the morning and ignore the report.
Look at the big picture rather than one exceptional shift.
Decide that the line has never produced anything useful.
Assume that annual costs are irrelevant to performance.

exp.trans: 厂长凭一次特别高产的上午就夸奖生产线，但年度报告显示反复延误及高额维修费。评价应着眼整体而非单次样本。
exp.structure: A factory manager + praised + a production line；however引出与单次乐观印象相反的长期证据；Which advice要求概括两边的关系。
exp.other: productive 高产的；annual report 年报；repair cost 维修费用；exceptional 例外的。
exp.meaning: look at the big picture表示看全局、顾及长期背景，避免单凭个别表现判断整体。
exp.rest: 只看那一个上午就是原文批评的做法；断言生产线毫无用处过度概括；完全忽略年度成本也背离证据。

questions.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
questions.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
questions.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

questions.target: 比较动作对象和工具所支持的任务
questions.skill: 比较动作对象和工具所支持的任务
questions.q: A conductor marks player availability on "section cards" and places them in a room-and-time grid to prevent rehearsal clashes. Players suggest new repertoire at a separate meeting. What is the role of the cards?
o: They provide a topic for sharing opinions about new music.
They record which new pieces players most want to perform.
They invite players to debate the meaning of section cards.
They organize which players rehearse in each room and slot.

exp.trans: 指挥把乐手可到场的时间写在卡片上，放入房间与时间表以避免排练冲突；乐手在另一个会议上建议新曲目。卡片发挥什么作用？
exp.structure: marks...places...to prevent给出动作与目的链；at a separate meeting把提出曲目的行为放在另一个活动中。
exp.other: availability可到场情况；clash冲突；repertoire曲目。
exp.meaning: 卡片用于人员、地点与时间的安排；讨论曲目不因文中同时出现音乐相关词就成为卡片的功能。
exp.rest: sharing opinions与debate改成讨论行为；record which new pieces误把时间可用性换成曲目偏好，均改变了动作对象。

questions.skill: 提示问题不等于审查或修改完成
questions.q: A night audit has flagged up a possible double booking, but the support team has not opened the case. Changing either reservation requires the customer's approval. Which stage has certainly been reached?
o: Both customers have approved changes to their rooms.
The support team has confirmed that an error occurred.
A possible clash has been marked for staff attention.
One reservation has already been revised and saved.

exp.trans: 夜间检查已提示可能存在重复预订，但客服尚未查看此事。更改任一预订还需要客户同意。现在只能确认潜在冲突已被标示出来，供工作人员关注。
exp.structure: A night audit为主语，has flagged up为谓语，a possible double booking为宾语；but后has not opened明确限制审查进度。Changing either reservation是第二句主语，requires为谓语，the customer's approval为宾语。
exp.other: audit检查、核查；double booking重复预订；reservation预订；approval同意、批准。
exp.meaning: 先提示可能有问题，再核查是否确有问题，必要时取得许可并修改。possible保留不确定性，不能把流程的后续步骤当成已经完成。
exp.rest: “两位客户都同意改动”没有依据；“客服确认错误”与尚未查看此事不符，也删掉possible；“已经修改并保存预订”跳过核查和授权。正确描述只停在已标示潜在冲突这一阶段。

questions.target: imagined that ... had not / 提取完整观点
questions.skill: 信念内容不能由后续结果倒推
questions.q: Noor imagined that a software update had not changed her machine's output. Later measurements showed a substantial change. Which statement describes Noor's initial belief?
o: She initially thought the update made no difference.
She had decided to replace the machine entirely.
She knew from the beginning that output had changed greatly.
She was excessively enthusiastic about software updates.

exp.trans: Noor起初认为更新没有改变机器产出，后来的测量才发现变化明显。
exp.structure: Noor imagined that...中that从句作宾语；had not changed是其核心否定谓语；Later measurements引出相反事实。
exp.other: output 产出；substantial 显著的；measurement 测量；initial 初始的。
exp.meaning: 必须区分人物当时相信什么与后来实际发现了什么；不能只因出现update就推定其对软件痴迷。
exp.rest: 更换机器无依据；把后来证据当成最初已知事实颠倒时间；过分热衷更新是附加心理描述。

questions.target: conscious choice与conscious of的搭配区别
questions.skill: conscious choice与conscious of的搭配区别
questions.q: A shopper makes a conscious choice to repair a bag after comparing costs and waste. The choice was considered in advance. What does conscious mean here?
o: Deliberate and made with awareness of the alternatives.
Accidental and made without noticing any alternatives.
Made instantly, with no comparison of possible options.
Evidence that the bag was selected by another person.

exp.trans: 购物者比较费用与废弃物后，有意识地选择修包，而且事先考虑过。这里conscious是什么意思？
exp.structure: conscious修饰choice；considered in advance解释这是经过意识与考虑的选择。
exp.other: alternative可选方案；deliberate有意的、经过考虑的。
exp.meaning: conscious随搭配可指意识到或有意识、刻意的；conscious choice不同于be conscious of，但都不应机械译为清醒着。
exp.rest: accidental与有意识的考虑相反；instantly...no comparison忽略事先比较；another person把选择主体换成他人，均未保留经过考虑的选择。

questions.target: 未确认形近词联想：按语境区分
questions.skill: 未确认形近词联想：按语境区分
questions.q: At a café, a faster oven is expected to ___ service. At dinner, the owner raises a glass for a ___ to the kitchen team. Which pair fits both sentences?
o: boast / roast
toast / boast
roast / boost
boost / toast

exp.trans: 咖啡馆的新烤箱预计能改善服务；晚餐时店主举杯向厨房团队祝酒。哪组词分别合适？
exp.structure: 第一个空格是支配service的动词，要求提升；a后接名词，raises a glass提供祝酒语境。
exp.other: oven烤箱；raise a glass举杯。
exp.meaning: boost可改善服务，a toast是祝酒。roast/toast在此作为教学辨析候选，不能据本题反推用户当时回忆的究竟是哪一个。
exp.rest: boast不能表达提高服务；roast表示烤制，不等于提高；toast放在service前也不能表达改善。形近不代表能共享句法宾语。

with.skill: 识别with复合结构的伴随状态
with.q: The archive reopened at noon, with several boxes waiting in the loading area. What does the with-clause do?
o: It describes a state accompanying the archive's reopening.
It gives the sole reason the archive reopened at noon.
It reports an action that archive staff carried out.
It is the direct object of reopened in the main clause.

exp.trans: 档案馆中午重新开放，当时有几个箱子正等在装卸区。with结构补充了重新开放时伴随的状态。
exp.structure: 主干是The archive reopened at noon；with several boxes waiting in the loading area是with + 名词 + 现在分词结构，several boxes是waiting的逻辑主语。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；reopen 重新开放；loading area 装卸区；accompany 伴随。
exp.meaning: with复合结构常补充主句发生时的伴随状态。它不是reopened的直接宾语，也不自动表达原因或目的。
exp.rest: 句子没有说明这是档案馆重新开放的唯一原因；with短语描述箱子所处的状态，并未说工作人员另做了一项动作；reopened在这里是不及物动词，不需要直接宾语。

cloze-big-picture.target: the big picture / 整体背景
cloze-big-picture.q: The emergency office assessed drought risk using only last week's rainfall. A researcher urged officials to examine five years of climate data and consider ______ before announcing a new water policy.
o: the next visitor
a single newspaper headline
the big picture
an unrelated complaint

exp.trans: 应急部门仅凭上周降雨量评估干旱风险；研究者建议在宣布新供水政策前查看五年气候数据、考虑整体情况。
exp.structure: The emergency office是主语，assessed是谓语；A researcher urged officials to examine... and consider...，两个不定式动作共同构成建议。
exp.other: drought 干旱；rainfall 降雨量；climate data 气候数据；water policy 供水政策。
exp.meaning: the big picture是整体局面或全貌；与仅凭上周局部数据下判断形成鲜明对比，不是一个单独的大问题。
exp.rest: 下一位访客、某篇报道与无关投诉都不能概括五年的整体数据，无法解释作者要求扩大视野的目的。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 同关键词不等于篇章连接
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 同关键词不等于篇章连接
paragraph-order-discourse.q: Paragraph P: The seed collection has two packets called "winter bean". Records show that they came from different valleys and need different storage temperatures. Which paragraph should follow to address the problem just identified?
o: Winter beans also appear in recipes collected from cooks.
Each packet will keep its local name plus a unique code.
The collection began when a gardener donated bean seeds.
Beans become tender when heated for a sufficient period.

exp.trans: 两个同名种子包来自不同山谷、需不同储温。哪段最适合接着解决刚提出的问题？
exp.structure: two packets called同名与different来源/条件共同制造识别风险；后段需同时保留本地名和区分身份。
exp.other: packet小包；storage储存；unique code唯一编码。
exp.meaning: 主题词bean重复不足以证明相邻；唯一编码回应同名异物的具体关系。
exp.rest: recipes转到烹饪；collection began倒退背景；tender讨论烹煮，都没有处理同名种子识别问题。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 并列与递进的段落功能
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 并列与递进的段落功能
paragraph-order-discourse.q: P: Singers can practise difficult rhythms by clapping. Q: They can also hum the melody without words to check pitch. R: A rehearsal combines both exercises before restoring the lyrics. Which account of the paragraph roles is accurate?
o: P and Q are rival results; R rejects both as unsuccessful.
P explains a failure; Q supplies its cause; R changes topic.
P and Q offer parallel methods; R combines their use.
P is a conclusion; Q gives its premise; R introduces P.

exp.trans: P拍手练节奏，Q哼唱检查音高，R把两项合并排练再恢复歌词。段落作用是什么？
exp.structure: also标出另一方法；both回收前两种练习；combines才是从方法列举转向组合应用的推进。
exp.other: hum哼唱；pitch音高；lyrics歌词。
exp.meaning: P/Q并列而非彼此因果；R在并列方法之上推进到综合应用。
exp.rest: rival results...rejects虚构竞争和失败；failure...cause虚构因果；P is a conclusion颠倒介绍与总结的位置。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An essay introduces software that restores damaged musical scores, shows one rhythm error it produced, and explains how musicians can check its output. Which closing paragraph best fits that argument?
o: Human checks help; useful output can still contain errors.
The history of ticket prices now needs a detailed account.
All restored notes must be right whenever software is used.
One rhythm error proves that every digital tool is useless.

exp.trans: 文章介绍修复乐谱的软件，展示一处节奏错误，再解释音乐家如何核验。哪段适合结尾？
exp.structure: 开头对象、错误例证、核验措施共同约束末段；结尾应合并优势与限制，不另起无关话题或扩大为全称断言。
exp.other: score乐谱；restore修复；output输出结果。
exp.meaning: 全局位置要检查论证链是否闭合；技术有用与仍需人类核验可以同时成立。
exp.rest: ticket prices另起无关话题；All restored notes把能力夸成保证；every digital tool把单例扩大为全体无用。

semantic-action-roles.target: 工具用途与讨论话题：动作、对象和主体
semantic-action-roles.skill: 工具用途与讨论话题：动作、对象和主体
semantic-action-roles.q: A repair cooperative lends a "bridge kit", a spare wheel that riders return when their damaged wheel is ready. Skills clinics also let members exchange repair methods. What does the evidence establish about the bridge kit?
o: It gives members a place to exchange methods of wheel repair.
Temporary equipment keeps riders moving during wheel repairs.
It records views on the methods taught at the repair clinics.
A bridge-kit forum lets members debate which repairs are best.

exp.trans: 维修合作社把备用车轮称为bridge kit，借给顾客直到原车轮修好；技能课另外提供交流维修方法的机会。关于备用车轮能确定什么？
exp.structure: lends与return构成临时借用关系；when从句限定归还时间。Skills clinics是另一个承担交流功能的主体，不能把它的动作转给bridge kit。
exp.other: cooperative合作社；spare备用的；clinic在此指技能指导课。
exp.meaning: 正确概括可用temporary equipment同义改写spare wheel；保留repair、methods等词却把借用设备换成讨论工具，是动作和角色偷换。
exp.rest: place to exchange与forum把实体备用轮当成讨论场所；records views把交流或记录功能添加给车轮。提到维修这一共同话题不够。

semantic-action-roles.target: 改选证据强度：语义证据优于词面重合
semantic-action-roles.skill: 改选证据强度：语义证据优于词面重合
semantic-action-roles.q: An orienteering club gives walkers a "route card" on which they mark completed checkpoints. At meetings, members exchange views about route difficulty. A reader first selects "recording progress", then prefers "exchanging views on route cards" for its repeated words. Which detail should control the choice?
o: Walkers put checkpoint marks on their cards during the walk.
The meetings discuss routes using a closely related noun.
The two answer choices contain similar numbers of words.
The later answer came to mind after reading the text again.

exp.trans: 定向活动给行走者卡片，用来标记已通过的检查点；会议另讨论路线难度。读者因重复词而想把记录进度改成交流路线卡观点。应以哪条细节判断？
exp.structure: on which引出卡片上的具体动作；at meetings转入另一场合。要核对谁在何处对什么做了什么，而非只看route重复。
exp.other: orienteering定向活动；checkpoint检查点；progress进度。
exp.meaning: 检查点标记直接支持记录完成进度；会议存在并不证明卡片是交换观点的讨论对象。初选受支持，是因为具体证据，不是因为它更早出现。
exp.rest: closely related noun只证明词汇相关；numbers of words是形式线索；later...again只是判断发生得晚，都没有推翻卡片用于记录这一语义证据。

semantic-action-roles.target: 正确改选也要有正确理由
semantic-action-roles.skill: 正确改选也要有正确理由
semantic-action-roles.q: A notice says a library is launching a "lending circle". A reader initially expects book loans. The full definition says the circle meets to debate borrowing rules and issues no books itself. Which response and reason are warranted?
o: Revise, since later sentences always replace earlier ones.
Keep, since a familiar word fixes the purpose on its own.
Revise, since the full definition identifies rule discussion.
Keep, since initial answers are generally more reliable.

exp.trans: 图书馆推出lending circle，读者起初以为是借书活动；完整定义说明这是讨论借阅规则的小组，本身不发书。哪种处理及理由成立？
exp.structure: The full definition明确限定名称指什么；issues no books排除把它理解为放贷或发书服务。
exp.other: notice通知；issue在此为发出、提供；warranted有依据的。
exp.meaning: 新语义证据可推翻基于名称的初步理解。本题确实应改选；不能把此前一次正确改错总结成永远相信初选。
exp.rest: later sentences always虽选了修改，却用了错误的普遍规则；familiar word与initial answers都让词面或时间顺序压过清楚定义。

relation-collocation.target: set A apart from B / be closely tied
relation-collocation.q: The company keeps approval and sales decisions formally separate precisely because the two teams are closely tied through shared bonuses. Which reading is best?
o: 两个团队彼此没有关系，所以没有必要区分决策。
两个团队现实利益联系紧密，因此制度上反而需要刻意把两类决策分开。
shared bonuses证明销售团队已经接管审批团队。
closely tied表示两个团队被绳子绑在一起。

exp.trans: 公司之所以在制度上把审批与销售决策分开，恰恰是因为两个团队通过共同奖金存在紧密利益联系。
exp.structure: The company是主语，keeps A and B separate是谓语结构；precisely because引出原因，the two teams是主语，are closely tied是系表结构。
exp.other: approval 审批；formally 正式地/制度上；bonus 奖金；shared 共同的。
exp.meaning: set/keep A apart/separate from B表示区分；be closely tied表示紧密相关。because并不要求“原因”和“措施”表面同方向：正因为现实容易纠缠，制度上才需要分开。
exp.rest: “没有关系、不必区分”与closely tied和keeps ... separate都相反；“销售团队接管审批团队”把利益联系夸大成组织控制，shared bonuses不能证明接管；“绳子绑在一起”按字面理解比喻性的关系搭配，无法解释共同奖金带来的利益联系。

relation-collocation.skill: 关系搭配 + 反直觉因果
relation-collocation.q: The audit office is structurally independent from the ministry because its work is closely tied to decisions the ministry would otherwise judge itself. What is the logic?
o: 工作联系紧密，所以两个机构不再需要制度独立。
审计涉及该部决定，制度独立可避免自己审自己。
审计内容相关，所以审计办公室必须直属部长。
because表达转折，前后两个分句没有因果关系。

exp.trans: 审计办公室在组织上独立于该部门，因为它的工作与该部门原本可能自行评判的决定紧密相关。正因为利益和事项联系密切，制度上才需要独立。
exp.structure: The audit office是主语，is structurally independent是系表；because从句中its work是主语，is closely tied to是谓语结构，decisions是介词宾语。
exp.other: audit 审计；structurally 组织结构上；ministry 部门/部；otherwise 否则。
exp.meaning: closely tied to=与……紧密相关；independent from=独立于。文章常出现“现实联系紧密→制度上刻意分离”的治理逻辑，不能因为表面反向就否定because。
exp.rest: 联系紧密就无需独立反转了治理理由；工作内容相关不等于必须直属部长；because引出原因，不是转折。制度独立针对的是同一部门可能自己评判自己的决定。

relation-collocation.q: The repair looks like replacing one cable, but there is more to it: the technician must also find the cause of the overheating and retest the circuit. What does "there is more to it" mean here?
o: The replacement requires a longer piece of cable.
The cable costs more than the other spare parts.
It involves further work beyond changing a cable.
It creates more faults than the tests can identify.

exp.trans: 维修表面上像是换根电缆，但事情还不止这些：技师还必须查明过热原因，并重新测试电路。
exp.structure: there is more to it是完整表达；it指维修这件事。冒号后的also与并列动作find、retest说明more具体增加了哪些工作。
exp.other: overheating 过热；circuit 电路；retest 重新测试。
exp.meaning: there is more to something表示某事比表面呈现的更复杂或包含更多内容；to连接所涉及的事情，不单独表示方向。
exp.rest: 电缆更长、价格更高都没有证据；后文是查因和复测，也没有说维修新制造了更多故障。

relation-collocation.target: 动作的施事与作用方式
relation-collocation.skill: 动作的施事与作用方式
relation-collocation.q: A map display shows travel time and price side by side; passengers remain free to ignore it. Which sentence best describes the function the display provides?
o: It forces passengers to follow the cheapest route.
It allows passengers to compare the route options.
It requires passengers to book before comparing.
It expects all passengers to make the same choice.

exp.trans: 地图界面并列显示行程时间和价格，乘客可以不使用它。它的作用是让乘客能够比较方案，而不是强制某种选择。
exp.structure: shows的主语是display；remain free的主语是passengers。allow/force/require/expect都可接宾语加to不定式，须进一步辨别语义。
exp.other: allow 允许、使能够；force 强迫；require 要求；expect 期待；side by side 并列地。
exp.meaning: 中文“让”可能表示使能够或迫使，英语并不总用同一个动词。要看工具提供能力，还是主体施加强制要求。
exp.rest: 强迫走最便宜路线和要求先订票都增加了没有出现的限制；期待所有人同选也没有证据，且不能准确表述并列显示信息提供的比较能力。

relation-collocation.q: A curator searched for a missing ledger. After finding it, she searched the ledger for a donation entry. Which description matches only the second search?
o: She examined the office to locate the ledger.
She examined the address to locate its owner.
She examined the ledger to locate an entry.
She examined the donor to locate the ledger.

exp.trans: 管理员先寻找一本失踪的账簿。找到后，她查看账簿，寻找一条捐赠记录。第二次搜索检查的是账簿，寻找的目标是记录。
exp.structure: 首句searched for后接寻找的目标a missing ledger；第二句searched的直接宾语是the ledger，for a donation entry说明要在其中寻找什么。After finding it中的it回指账簿，先找到它才进行第二个动作。
exp.other: curator藏品管理员；ledger账簿；donation捐赠；entry一条记录。
exp.meaning: search for X强调寻找X；search Y for X强调检查Y以寻找X。要分开标出被检查的范围和想找到的东西。
exp.rest: “检查办公室找账簿”把第二次查看内容换回寻找物品；“检查地址找主人”加入不存在的对象与目标；“检查捐赠人找账簿”把账簿中的记录换成了人。只有“检查账簿找记录”对应第二句。

relation-collocation.skill: 固定搭配与动作阶段辨析
relation-collocation.q: A walking-tour guide flagged up a shadeless stretch before the group set out. She kept the planned route and advised everyone to bring water. What did she do by flagging it up?
o: Highlighted it as something to prepare for.
Revised the route to leave that stretch out.
Stored the route for a later walking tour.
Found a shaded stretch to replace that part.

exp.trans: 徒步导游在出发前特别提醒大家有一段路没有遮阴。她保留原定路线，建议大家带水。flagged up在此表示指出这段路值得提前留意和准备。
exp.structure: 首句主语A walking-tour guide，谓语flagged up，宾语a shadeless stretch；before从句说明提醒的时间。第二句kept与advised为并列谓语，分别表明路线未改和提醒带水。
exp.other: walking tour徒步游览；shadeless无遮阴的；stretch一段路程；set out出发。
exp.meaning: flag up是整体搭配，表示使某事引起注意，不是由up推断向上或动作完成。这里提醒风险与修改路线是不同动作。
exp.rest: “修改路线避开该段”与kept the planned route矛盾；“储存路线供以后旅行”把提醒换成保存；“找到替代的遮阴路段”加入文中没有发生的发现和替换。只有“提醒大家提前准备”符合后续带水建议。

relation-collocation.q: Residents said the ferry meeting centered on trivial issues: paint colours and the ticket logo filled the agenda, while wheelchair access was never discussed. Which paraphrase keeps the whole meaning?
o: It took place in the town's central meeting room.
It put essential access problems first on the agenda.
It solved the main problem before discussing colours.
It focused on minor details and missed a major need.

exp.trans: 居民说渡轮会议围绕琐碎问题展开：议程尽是油漆颜色和票面标志，却从未讨论轮椅通行。准确改写应同时保留关注小细节及忽略重要需要这两层。
exp.structure: 主句Residents said后接宾语从句；其中the ferry meeting是主语，centered on是谓语搭配，trivial issues是其对象。冒号后具体说明trivial所指，while连接与未讨论无障碍通行的对照。
exp.other: ferry渡轮；agenda议程；logo标志；wheelchair access轮椅无障碍通行。
exp.meaning: center on指围绕、以……为中心；trivial评价问题的重要程度。只有保留搭配及其对象的含义，才是整句同义。
exp.rest: “在镇中心会议室举行”把center的动词义错成地点；“把重要通行问题放首位”颠倒原文；“已解决主要问题”给never discussed增添相反的结果。

relation-collocation.target: be centered on / 评价限定
relation-collocation.skill: 话题焦点与话题重要性
relation-collocation.q: An archive's restoration debate was centered on the cause of fading photographs. The minutes describe the damage as a serious loss and ask whether damp storage was responsible. Which description is supported?
o: Its focus was explaining the cause of serious damage.
Its purpose was arranging pictures around a centre.
It dealt mainly with matters of little importance.
It had already proved that damp storage was to blame.

exp.trans: 档案馆的修复讨论围绕照片褪色的原因展开。会议记录称这种损害是严重损失，并追问是否因存放潮湿所致。能确认讨论的焦点是解释严重损害的原因。
exp.structure: 首句The restoration debate为主语，was centered on为被动形式的动词搭配，the cause...为其对象；第二句describe和ask为并列谓语，whether引导待解问题。
exp.other: archive档案馆；restoration修复；minutes会议记录；damp潮湿的。
exp.meaning: be centered on只说明讨论围绕什么，不自动说明该问题琐碎、重大或已解决；这些限定必须另有文本证据。
exp.rest: “围绕一个中心摆放照片”误把抽象讨论当实体布置；“主要谈不重要的事”与serious loss相反；“已经证明潮湿是原因”把whether所表达的疑问变成了结论。

relation-collocation.q: The audit compared the repair costs of the northern depot as well as those of the southern depot. Which paraphrase preserves both objects of comparison?
o: It compared repair costs at both depots.
It compared the depots themselves, not their repair costs.
It considered only costs shared by the two depots.
It asked the southern depot to repair the northern one.

exp.trans: 审计比较了北部仓库和南部仓库的维修成本。as well as把后一个并列对象补充到前一个对象上；those of the southern depot中的those替代前面的复数名词costs。
exp.structure: 主干：The audit（主语）+ compared（谓语）+ the repair costs...（宾语）。宾语内部由the repair costs of the northern depot和those of the southern depot并列；those指代repair costs，of短语说明成本属于哪个仓库。
exp.other: audit审计；depot仓库/站点；repair cost维修成本；preserve保留。
exp.meaning: as well as在句中表示“以及/还有”；those of是名词替代结构，避免重复repair costs。判断并列时要看两个成分在语法和语义上是否对应。
exp.rest: 把仓库本身当比较对象，忽略了句子明确比较的是维修成本；只比较共同成本加入了only和shared的限制；让南部仓库修理北部仓库则凭空增加了维修动作。

relation-collocation.target: that of / 比较对象替代
relation-collocation.q: The failure rate of older pumps was higher than that of newer models. In this comparison, that of newer models refers to:
o: the age of the newer models
the failure rate of the newer models
the number of older pumps
the repair cost of the older models

exp.trans: 旧型号水泵的故障率高于新型号水泵的故障率。that替代前面的单数名词failure rate。
exp.structure: 比较结构为The failure rate of older pumps（比较对象一）+ was higher than + that of newer models（比较对象二）。that代替failure rate，of newer models限定这一故障率属于新型号。
exp.other: failure rate故障率；pump水泵；model型号；comparison比较。
exp.meaning: that of可替代前面出现的单数名词，避免重复。先确定被替代的名词，再确定of短语所属的对象。
exp.rest: newer models的年龄不是比较的指标；旧水泵的数量没有出现在比较结构中；repair cost是新添的指标，而且对象也不对。

relation-collocation.q: After marrying into the family that owns the bakery, Mira began helping with its accounts. What does marrying into the family mean?
o: She became part of the family through marriage.
She married every member of the family.
She arranged a marriage for the family.
She rented a room in the family's house.

exp.trans: 嫁入拥有这家面包店的家庭后，Mira开始帮忙处理账目。marry into the family表示通过婚姻成为这个家庭的一员。
exp.structure: After marrying into...是时间状语；主句Mira began helping...。that owns the bakery是修饰family的定语从句。
exp.other: bakery面包店；account账目；become part of成为……的一部分；through marriage通过婚姻。
exp.meaning: marry somebody表示与某人结婚；marry into a family表示通过婚姻进入某个家庭或社会关系。
exp.rest: 不是与家庭每一位成员分别结婚；不是替家庭安排婚事；也不是仅仅租住在家庭的房子里。

relation-collocation.q: The relief shipment reached the island by way of a smaller port after the main harbor closed. Here, by way of means:
o: through or via the smaller port
in order to repair the smaller port
because the smaller port had closed
instead of using any port at all

exp.trans: 主要港口关闭后，救援物资经由一个较小的港口抵达岛上。by way of表示经由、通过。
exp.structure: The relief shipment是主语，reached是谓语，the island是宾语；by way of a smaller port说明到达路线。
exp.other: relief shipment救援物资；harbor港口；via经由；close关闭。
exp.meaning: by way of + 地点表示经过某处、经由某处；此处说明路线，不表示目的或原因。
exp.rest: in order to表达目的，原句没有修港口的动作；because表示原因，不能解释到达路线；instead of表示替代，且与物资实际经过小港口相反。

relation-collocation.q: After the supervisor demonstrated the procedure, the trainee completed the calibration on his own. Here, on his own means:
o: without help from another person
under the supervisor's direct control
using equipment that belongs to him
because he had no other assignment

exp.trans: 主管演示流程后，实习人员独自完成了校准。on his own表示独自地、没有他人帮助。
exp.structure: After引导时间状语；主句the trainee completed the calibration，on his own补充说明完成动作的方式。
exp.other: supervisor主管；procedure流程；trainee实习人员；calibration校准。
exp.meaning: on one's own常表示独自完成或不依靠他人；这里描述完成校准时的独立状态。
exp.rest: under direct control表示受主管控制，与独自完成相反；设备所有权不是句子重点；没有其他任务也不是on his own的含义。

relation-collocation.target: as well as / 附加范围
relation-collocation.q: Access to the laboratory is granted to visiting researchers as well as to permanent staff. Which statement follows?
o: Both groups may receive laboratory access.
Only permanent staff may enter the laboratory.
Visiting researchers replace permanent staff.
Only researchers with permanent contracts may apply.

exp.trans: 实验室既向来访研究人员开放，也向正式员工开放。as well as把第二类适用对象补充到第一类对象上。
exp.structure: Access is granted to A as well as to B；两个to短语处于并列层级，分别表示获得访问权限的两类人。
exp.other: access访问权限；visiting researcher来访研究人员；permanent staff正式员工；grant给予。
exp.meaning: as well as表示“以及/也包括”，在这里扩展规则适用对象，并不排除前一个对象。
exp.rest: only把规则缩小到正式员工；replace把补充关系改成替代关系；permanent contracts是原文没有提出的额外条件。

belief-negation-clause.target: assume that ... did not / 被批评的信念
belief-negation-clause.q: A restaurant owner rebuked an apprentice for assuming that the online booking page did not influence walk-in customers. Surveys showed that many visitors discovered the restaurant through the page. What did the apprentice mistakenly believe?
o: The owner had avoided creating an online booking page.
Walk-in customers were unaffected by the booking page.
Customers preferred online orders to meals at the restaurant.
The owner placed excessive importance on online advertising.

exp.trans: 老板批评学徒，因为学徒以为网上订位页面不影响未经预约直接到店的人；调查却显示不少访客就是经此页面了解餐厅。
exp.structure: rebuked an apprentice为主干，for assuming that...说明批评原因，that后的did not influence是学徒持有的错误判断。
exp.other: rebuke 责备；apprentice 学徒；walk-in customer 无预约上门顾客；reservation 预约。
exp.meaning: assume/imagine that表示以为、认为；否定词位于从句中，决定被批评的是低估作用而非对网络的痴迷。
exp.rest: 老板未建网页和顾客点餐偏好均无证据；把老板说成过分重视广告，也没有回答学徒错误地否认网页对临时到店顾客的影响。

conscious-awareness.target: be conscious of / be aware of
conscious-awareness.skill: be conscious of / be aware of
conscious-awareness.q: The editor is conscious of the noise from the next room and moves the recording session. Which paraphrase preserves conscious of?
o: The editor deliberately creates all the noise in the next room.
The editor is unconscious while the recording takes place.
The editor is aware of the noise and adjusts the arrangement.
The editor knows nothing about the noise during recording.

exp.trans: 编辑意识到隔壁噪声，便调整录音安排。conscious of如何改写？
exp.structure: be conscious of后接所察觉的对象；moves the session说明意识到噪声之后的调整，不说明他制造了噪声。
exp.other: recording session录音场次；arrangement安排。
exp.meaning: conscious of是意识到、察觉到，不只是生理清醒；aware of保留这一关系。
exp.rest: creates偷换为制造噪声；unconscious方向相反；knows nothing也否定了已经意识到。

boast-boost-distinction.q: An apprentice knows how to repair clocks but doubts her ability. The instructor wants the next task to ___ her confidence; she is not being asked to brag about past work. Which verb fits?
o: boast
roast
boost
toast

exp.trans: 学徒会修钟表，却缺乏信心。老师希望下个任务提高她的信心，并非让她夸耀旧成绩。哪个动词合适？
exp.structure: 空格动词直接支配her confidence，要求表达提高；boast about才通常引出夸耀的对象。
exp.other: apprentice学徒；brag夸耀。
exp.meaning: boost confidence表示提高信心；boast与boost字形相近但不能互换。
exp.rest: boast表示夸耀或拥有值得自豪之物，不表示提高信心；roast是烘烤，toast可烤面包或祝酒，都不符合此宾语关系。

boast-boost-distinction.q: A brochure says the museum "boasts a rare textile archive". A new grant will "boost access" by paying for longer opening hours. What is the distinction?
o: The museum has a valued collection; the grant improves access.
The museum increases the collection; the grant praises access.
The museum brags about visitors; the grant stores their records.
The museum sells its old textiles; the grant cuts their price.

exp.trans: 手册说博物馆boasts珍贵纺织档案；新资助通过延长开放时间boost access。两词有什么区别？
exp.structure: boasts后直接接具有吸引力的收藏，采用拥有义；boost支配access，表示提高可接近程度。
exp.other: textile纺织品；archive档案；grant资助。
exp.meaning: boast不仅有夸耀义，还可表示拥有值得自豪之物；它仍不能泛译为增加。boost表示改善或提升。
exp.rest: increases...praises把拥有与提升两种语义互换；brags about visitors改了原宾语；sells...cuts their price添加文中没有的出售和降价。

boast-boost-distinction.q: A museum adds guards to beef up security. Its guides practise listening exercises to sharpen their skills. Which pair preserves the two meanings?
o: Praise protection / announce new skills
Strengthen protection / improve skills
Define protection / share past skills
Remove protection / limit new skills

exp.trans: 博物馆增加安保人员以加强保卫；讲解员做听力练习以磨炼技能。哪组含义正确？
exp.structure: adds guards为beef up的增强义提供动作证据；practise...to sharpen说明练习用于提高技能。
exp.other: guard安保人员；security保卫；listening exercise听力练习。
exp.meaning: beef up与sharpen skills可在增强能力这一语境近义；不把beef或sharpen一律按食物或磨刀直译。
exp.rest: Praise/announce只是称赞或宣布；Define/share只是定义或分享；Remove/limit反转了增强方向。
